title: Peruvian Hangover Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Peruvian-inspired stew to soothe a hangover. This dish is rich in flavor and can be made with readily available ingredients.
instructions: 1. Peel and chop the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
2. Heat a large pot over medium heat.
3. Add the pungent Peruvian chili to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the chopped potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
5. Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
7. Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
8. If desired, add the hangover cure to the stew for an extra kick.
9. Serve the stew hot and enjoy.
